title: Exposure · noun
subtitle: 「接觸／經驗／熟悉／曝光／風險」，究竟是哪一種 exposure？
description: 「接觸／經驗／熟悉／曝光／風險」，究竟是哪一種 exposure？

words.note: 使用者提供。這是 exposure 最核心、最直接的改寫之一，尤其適合 people, substances, ideas, languages, environments。它強調實際接觸到某人、某物或某種影響來源。
words.example: Regular contact with native speakers can improve listening skills.

exercises.original: Repeated exposure to loud noise can damage hearing.
exercises.zh: 反覆接觸巨大噪音可能損害聽力。
exercises.upgrade: contact with · 接觸；與……接觸

options.explanation: loud noise + hearing damage describes direct contact with a harmful stimulus.

words.note: 較窄。exposure 在 finance, insurance, health-and-safety 等語境可指『承受某種風險的程度』。用 risk 改寫時要有明確 downside/harm/loss 線索；它不是一般 contact 的同義詞。
words.example: The firm reduced its risk by diversifying its investments.

falseSynonyms.zh: contact 強調直接接觸；exposure 可進一步表示經驗、媒體曝光或風險承擔。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Contact with the chemical should be limited. The artist gained international exposure.

falseSynonyms.zh: experience 表示親身經歷／所得經驗；單純看到或接觸某物未必已形成 experience。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She has experience of client meetings. The course gives students exposure to different industries.

falseSynonyms.zh: familiarity 是接觸後形成的熟悉程度；exposure 可以只是第一次或短暫接觸。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He has familiarity with the software. He had brief exposure to the system.

falseSynonyms.zh: access 強調有沒有機會／權限接觸；exposure 強調實際接觸本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Students have access to the archive. Students gain exposure to historical documents.

falseSynonyms.zh: interaction 必須有雙向參與；單向看到、聽到、接觸並不一定是 interaction。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Students interacted with local artists. Students had exposure to local art.

falseSynonyms.zh: publicity 只處理公共／媒體關注；化學、語言或工作 exposure 不能改成 publicity。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The interview generated publicity. The workers had chemical exposure.

falseSynonyms.zh: visibility 是被看見的程度；exposure 還可表示接觸、經驗和風險。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The campaign increased online visibility. Early exposure to music can shape preferences.

falseSynonyms.zh: exposure 是名詞；exposed 是形容詞／過去分詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The exposure was limited. The workers were exposed to noise.
